anchor: 单任务成本：半价并不总是靠谱
purpose: 补充原有成本数据截图，用视觉隐喻解释单价低但总消耗高
prompt: Generate one standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration. Visual DNA: Pure white background. Minimalist black hand-drawn line art with slightly wobbly pen lines, lots of empty white space, clean absurd product-sketch feeling. No gradients, shadows, paper texture, complex background, commercial vector style, PPT infographic look, cute mascot poster, children's illustration, or realistic UI. Recurring IP character required: 小黑, a small solid-black cat with white dot eyes, simple pointed ears, a short tail, tiny thin legs, blank serious expression, slightly uneven hand-drawn body shape. 小黑 must perform the core conceptual action and must not look cute or kawaii. Theme: a cheap per-token price can produce a more expensive total bill. Structure type: conceptual metaphor. Core idea: unit price is only the price tag; total token consumption determines the final bill. Composition: In the center, 小黑 seriously pushes a tiny shopping cart marked with a small warm-gold $2 price tag. An absurdly long accordion-fold receipt made of token strips pours out behind the cart, loops across the floor, climbs onto a large red weighing scale, and makes the cheap side sink lower than a compact premium box on the opposite side. 小黑 strains against the cart while staring blankly at the oversized final bill. Suggested elements: tiny cheap price tag / endless folded token receipt / red overloaded scale / compact premium box. Chinese handwritten labels: 单价低 / Token 暴涨 / 总账单 / 半价? Color use: black for line art and 小黑; matte warm gold #A07848 only for the cheap price tag and token path; red only for the overloaded scale and warning mark; blue only for one small secondary note. One image explains only this core metaphor. Keep the main subject around 45%-55% of the canvas and preserve at least 35% blank white space. Use no more than four short Chinese labels. Do not write a title in the top-left. Do not make a formal chart, course slide, or dense explainer. Invent a fresh composition. Clear but not instructional, strange but clean.
